source: Two load tests of the predictive Kubernetes autoscaling project (run 1 reactive, run 2 predictive). Values read from Grafana screenshots, ±30 s (the Grafana exports are no longer available, so no CSV script). x = seconds relative to traffic arrival (t = 0: combined network TX first above 10% of the run's peak), on a 30 s grid. predictive / reactive = ready pods as % of the run's final count; traffic = mean of both runs' combined TX as % of its peak.
